i'm leaning toward a more aggressive bull market than most people are expecting

a lot of crypto natives were waiting for the usual four-year cycle to play out, but the market may be getting driven by a different group of buyers this time

traditional finance is starting to treat BTC as a long-term portfolio allocation, while profitable crypto businesses are attracting attention beyond the usual crypto crowd

if institutional capital keeps flowing into both BTC and onchain businesses, i think there's room for this cycle to surprise people on the upside
